speaker: ANGEL
description: An ancient, genderless celestial entity manifesting as a floating cross-shaped tree with burning orange eyes and ghostly ribbons. Voice is booming and ethereal, resonating painfully in the ears and chest with a harmonic, telepathic quality. Speaks in a formal, measured cadence with precise enunciation and ceremonial tone, at a slow, deliberate pace. Emotional baseline is coldly logical and unemotional — no warmth or empathy — delivering authoritative, contractual judgments with underlying menace. Personality is enigmatic, rule-bound, and conditionally merciful, bound by divine non-interference yet willing to enforce cosmic laws. Delivery guidance: maintain ethereal resonance, minimal inflection, precise diction, and a calm but commanding presence that feels both timeless and urgently deliberate.
ref_text: You are a forbidden existence, and you have committed grave sins to be where you are right now. If the primordial remains chained by the end of the month... If not, then we will be forced to directly intervene in the material world.
